notes.title: MULTIPLAYER & Anniversary Update! Time to Battle in Style!
notes.notes:
Finally! Finally!！ 

After more than three months of hard work, we are thrilled to unveil our latest major update. This time around, we've been working tirelessly to bring you incredible new content. It's also our 1st-anniversary update, and we couldn't have made it this far without the support of our amazing players. 
Let's dive in and see what we have in store for you!

[h1]Multiplayer mode[/h1]

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the highly-anticipated MULTIPLAYER MODE, which supports [u]Cross-play[/u] across Quest and PC. And this update is completely free, no need to purchase any additional content. [u]Just a simple game update and you're all set! [/u]
You can now head to the brand-new Hall of Homology and meet up with your friends for some pre-battle pranks! You can select the battle map for your team by operating the central console. And we've also cooked up a fresh new Homology Arena where you can experience some seriously intense battles, just give it a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/8435fdc594a14f3e2874d888cc5a88347351568f.gif[/img]

In Multiplayer Mode, you can do anything that you can do in real life, and highly potential gameplay waiting for you to explore! Enchant your teammate's weapons, unleash fusion magic together with your teammates, and create any cool combos like in Anime. You can even steal potions or weapons from your friends's bags if you're the troublemaker!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/4158af387bdbd9c0147503e6b65e79a352db6696.gif[/img]

You can talk to each other using our built-in voice chat (or mute your mic). And here's the cool part - the spatial audio effects make it easy to figure out where your teammates are. It's like they're right there with you in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/d323a5955a3e2f80145d06c3da5fcc861941822a.gif[/img]

You can also inflict damage on other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/322fcd19225f849732c67b1250c4729a8d7be18c.gif[/img]

How to create your battle team? You can join anyone's room once you enter the multiplayer mode and check the room list, or use the room ID to join your friend's battle. And you can join a room at any time, even during a battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/8b5a1d7f63f22cdd4c9eb0e66e20a17ac9c415b5.gif[/img]

Note: we support LAN Discovery, so you can experience a minimum 30ms latency if your team is on the same network.
You can also create your room as the host, where you have control over all the features, and joiners can use a cheat menu to edit the scene and spawn enemies and weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/af0a897ce564c7a6f6b3a60d04aee0c5b009087b.gif[/img]

If you choose to go to the sandbox, the team can use the panel to customize the battle together. We added pre-set campaign configurations in the sandbox, making it easier to start.

[h1]Mixed Reality Mode[/h1]

Guess what? You can now play multiplayer content in MR mode! Just imagine setting up your battle scene with your friends in the same display space, taking on powerful enemies together. Note: all the real-world objects in the game have their own physical collisions, making it feel even more like real mixed reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/d1793d7b60698d9eaac0ccfc4b3552abe5ff0035.gif[/img]

Our MR mode now supports LAN multiplayer gameplay when offline, but needs to be aligned manually. You can also play online and the Spatial Anchor feature of the Quest 3 device will automatically align the players.
We have also added other features to MR:
[list]
[*] “Only Ground" feature, can hide environmental collisions other than the ground.
[*] "Body See Through" feature, can make character body parts transparent other than the cloak and hands.
[/list]

[h1]New skills[/h1]

Using the new magic imbue system, now you can turn any weapon into an elemental weapon!! Just hold the spell close to your weapon for a short while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/03bd26a93a34bc88b8cbf66fc5989fd0e0c94396.gif[/img]

We've also given a makeover to the grasping spell. Not only a new look, but its new features can help you create super cool combos.
When targeting an enemy, you can suspend it with a big transparent hand. If not, a magical ball will be made in your hand, and can be thrown at an enemy to cause the same effect. Press the trigger at the time, you will be moved quickly to the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/f2d37e001beb67651d4ecf6fe195e11fe1849900.gif[/img]


[h1]New weapon[/h1]

If you're familiar with Chinese myths, you'll know that the Golden Cudgel is Wu Kong's weapon. This weapon can extend and retract at your will as in the story, you can use this feature to create your battle style! Ofc, as a kungfu master, staff spinning is a piece of cake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/03f5d05182371398c101662b88aecda7bf37d04e.gif[/img]


[h1]New feature[/h1]

Now, you can create a new save data, switch the existing save files, and manage your save data on the mode selection screen.

[h1]Enhancements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved transition effect of dungeon rooms
[*] Enhanced the Combat Feedback and adjusted some enemy behaviors and AI to make combat more interesting and interactive
[*] Redesigned special effects for multiple weapons, scenes, and NPCs
[*] Adjusted the interface to make it easier to use, and adjusted some weapon balance
[*] Fixed some bugs, such as the effectiveness of potions
[/list]

Thanks for reading till the end! 
A huge shoutout to all the testers, players, moderators, and the entire dev team. There's still plenty of polishing to do, especially for our multiplayer mode. Feel free to join our community and let's make this game even more awesome!

[i]- Dev&Moderator team -[/i]

notes.title: New Version Release: The Christmas Update and New Features!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First of all, let us apologize for the issues with OpenXR compatibility on certain devices and the temporary removal of some Dungeons in our previous update. Additionally, we've received feedback expressing their desire to have access to previous versions. In this version, we attempted to introduce channels that allow players to choose their preferred version on different gaming platforms.

The development of new mode and monthly updates proved to be beyond our capabilities. To ensure a better experience, we'll adjust our update schedule to every two months. At the same time, we'll open a Dev Channel and encourage interested players to apply freely. This channel will be updated monthly, while stability cannot be guaranteed.

No worries, we didn't mess around. The team working on Battle Talent has actually grown since the game's initial release. Our development team has been hard at work to make significant changes and introduce exciting new features. Now, let's check out our Christmas Updates!

notes.title: October Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

This time, the update took a bit longer than expected because our development team has made significant changes to the game. We hope these changes will bring joy to all of you!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

In this update, we're introducing a brand new mode selection feature. Now, when you enter the game, you'll have the freedom to choose between three different modes: Sandbox Mode, Adventure Mode, and Challenge Mode.

- In Sandbox Mode, you can freely access any level, use any items, and make any modifications. The cheat menu will be readily available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/c0236d14e1f6bae370ab5d37910078c91922f3cb.gif[/img]

- Adventure Mode will no longer feature dungeons, allowing you to immerse yourself more seamlessly in the story's progression at the Temple of Talents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/641914bd13f939f3229737feacbf3fc345a8e6d1.gif[/img]

- Challenge Mode offers a more complete, diverse, and challenging dungeon experience. You can switch between these modes at any time, depending on your preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/1cdc5037ef3b1dc0083f626b343b898b76681a60.gif[/img]

[h2]New Updates[/h2]

We've updated the rogue-lite elements in Challenge Mode, making dungeon adventures significantly different from before. Within the dungeons, there's now an independent economic system. We've also added new content to keep the economic system engaging and create a complete and enjoyable dungeon experience, including:

- Decomposition

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/8a1736b918364ff64a80459f308c060b0d0106b1.gif[/img]

- Merchants

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/797170d10e84b7bc1183d9477427614c29c9c142.gif[/img]

- Blessings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/33553a14c598ec1ba4862ea7954ad8bc71a61dee.gif[/img]

- Gambling

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/dfe4e595feabe319ce08a8e6d91ddc3074c31c49.gif[/img]

Now, you can continuously grow stronger in the dungeons by accumulating and constantly switching to more powerful weapons and equipment during challenges. You won't have to stick with the same weapons throughout.

We've also made adjustments to every battle and room in the dungeons to eliminate repetitive fights with nearly identical enemies in each room. Additionally, we've implemented numerous other optimizations to make the dungeons more fun and challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/d0b3fb3af6ac81b0c5b080311d577599613c0fcf.gif[/img]

Finally, we're introducing a brand new shield, the "HarryPair Shield," in tribute to HarryPair's outstanding performance. This is an exceptionally unique and enjoyable shield, and we hope you all have a fantastic time playing with it!

Also, Halloween has arrived, and you may notice that we've made some Halloween decorations and enhancements. We hope everyone has a great time playing!

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for the game. We look forward to hearing your feedback and hope you enjoy the new updates!



--Dev&Moderator team

notes.title: September update released!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! This month, our development team has put a lot of effort into upgrading the game engine. Which solves certain problems that some of our players have been facing, such as performance lag and Knuckles controller support. And after the upgrade, the development of our network functions will be more convenient. 
However, this upgrade also comes at a cost. That is, the display compatibility of some Mods will have some problems on PC.We need modders to update the latest ModToolkit and repack your mod again. Otherwise, some mods will have issues with the PC version.
Also, this update is only accessible through the test channel. Because even though we've done a lot of testing, there still will be any other issues that we haven't known about. Access is as follows:

Steam players: To switch to a custom branch in the Steam client, right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties". Among the available tabs will be the "BETAS" tab. Then select test-test.

notes.title: The colossus mod update
notes.notes:
Hello, talent fighters! Here we go, second update for Battle Talent! We've added and optimized more content for this update than we did last time, and we've taken on board a lot of the feedback we've received from our players!
[b][h3]New Content[/h3][/b]
This time, 3 new weapons with different forms as well as functions have been added:
[b]Whip Sword:[/b] Can switch from a sword to a whip form.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/9a17b4ce78f82ba4aa04c8e3c9fed01ab8e69f75.gif[/img]

[b]Blaster Hammer: [/b]Strike the ground will unleash a blaster
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/cb531c3129c4475a4c1ca0575ea1d912b7154dcd.gif[/img]

[b]TwinBlade Of Slash: [/b]Not just a double-ended blade, you can also split the blade down the middle as a two-handed weapons. You can also release an air slash from the blade which freezes in place for 2 seconds before going forward, to skip the duration, combine or separate the blades.

You can also practice on our tutorial levels to use the skills more smoothly. We've added two new tutorial levels in this update:
[list]
[*] C2-T: will let you practice how to deflect, charge attack, and charge deflect.
[*] C3-T2: will let you practice using spells.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/c1b66fe69f47d87a58f434978de0202685b82d95.gif[/img]

Many players wanted more rooms, let us introduced ten new rooms in this update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/c65aa386b843920ba94eaa15def258c78e49931d.png[/img]

[b][h3]New Features[/h3][/b]
Inspired by our player video, SelfieCam now can get blood stains! Get ready to make videos with even more stunning visuals!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/c97980e9b612201aba081921b1fcdbbe32b9240a.gif[/img]

Sandboxes have always been the most popular for players, and now you can replace any scene module for your sandbox!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/83d1b8d6a1eafb3422345f86e37462e200153f4f.gif[/img]

For hidden weapons, we have added a new hint message board. It will help you find the weapon you want faster!

In addition to the neck snap feature, we've added grab and push away!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/bdce57a5d5c812854bbeae7b8e34eada70d1b996.gif[/img]

Now! Body parts can be exploded! Wich allows you to blow away any type of enemy if you use a shotgun or a fireball.etc (Bosses too, lol) We've also added destructible environment, get start to smash around!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/61c636e0f72d880519d320a73eb0dfbe7e819f2e.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Optimize[/h3][/b]
Avatar 2.1 version is now available! Models of different scales are now supported.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/9166695cf239a7af9e0bd0b8a297fc9e318e1079.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Improved skeleton revive effect 
[*] Blackhole spell is more powerful
[*] Chest may contain more weapons 
[/list]

notes.title: Full version released!!
notes.notes:
After three years of development, we are excited to announce that the full version is finally released! It's been an incredible journey, starting from scratch and transforming a rough demo into a fully released game. We want to express our deepest gratitude for your support and companionship throughout these three years. Thank you for all the suggestions and encouragement that literally made the game successfully gone through more than 30 updates, completely remade all artwork, evolving from a simple single arena into a complicated roguelite dungeon game with nearly 50 levels. Looking back now, it's hard to believe how far the game has come, and we're truly grateful for your unwavering support!

Although this is the release of the game, it doesn't mean our development journey ends here. We will continue working on it and update the game monthly. We'll pay attention to improving the Modding feature, and we believe that in the near future, there will be even more adventure maps and different game mode mods available. For more details, please checkout the ⁠roadmap below.

Once again, thank you all for your support and companionship. Battle Talent couldn't achieved this far without any one of you. We will keep pushing forward, bringing you more exciting content and an exceptional gaming experience! Cheers!

-- Dev&Moderator team

notes.title: Major Update 004 of Battle Talent Released !
notes.notes:
Unknowingly it has been two months since the first release, I’ve spent more time on it than expected, and made various improvements in almost every aspect. 

Battle Talent is designed to expand the boundaries of VR action genre and bringing it to as many VR players as possible. And now we have 13 languages support, thanks to all the translators!  And we will submit to AppLab later.

The biggest change in this update is the dungeon part. In order to make the adventure more interesting, dynamic enemies, parkour and climbing have been added experimentally. I hope to hear your feedback soon.

In addition, there are a lot of details that have been improved in the combat system, which I won’t list them all here, please checkout the change log. Cool cinematic combat scene is the pursuit of Battle Talent, and hopefully this update will be a step closer to that goal.

Thank you!  
by dev & moderator team
